{{recipesummary|category=Curry recipes|servings=10|time=30 minutes|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Indian Cuisine]]

'''Malai mixed vegetable''', is a creamy side dish for Indian bread.

==Ingredients==
* 3 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|capsicums]] (bell peppers)
* 1 each orange, yellow, and red capsicum
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Paneer|paneer]] cubes
* [[Cookbook:Cashew|Cashew nuts]]
* 4 large [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]]
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|green chillies]] (depending on spice requirement), finely chopped
* Dried [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]] and [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Garam Masala|Garam masala]]
* [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|Red chilli powder]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Turmeric|Turmeric]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]]
* 1 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Cilantro|Cilantro]] for garnishing

==Procedure==

# Cut the bell peppers into ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] paneer until golden brown; set aside.
# Soak a handful of cashew nuts in warm water.
# Grind the tomatoes and the soaked cashew into a fine paste. Keep this paste aside.
# Sauté the chopped vegetables, green chillies, and dried parsley in the butter/oil until they are cooked. You could also microwave the vegetables for ~10 minutes without water, and then sauté them in butter for a minute.
# Add the tomato paste to the vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
# Add the garam masala, red chilli powder, salt, and turmeric according to taste; [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 2 minutes.
# Add the whipping cream and the sour cream, and let it cook until the cream thickens.
# Add the paneer and mix well.
# [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with cilantro and cashew nuts.
# Serve hot with [[Cookbook:Naan|naan]] or [[Cookbook:Roti|roti]].

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* You could choose other vegetables like [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]] or [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli]] if you like.
